product: Optional raw-source retrieval for generated LLM Wiki vaults

stories.title: Build a separate incremental raw lexical index
acceptanceCriteria: SQLite-enabled scaffolds include one self-contained raw retrieval CLI and SQLite-disabled scaffolds do not.
The CLI maintains state/raw_index.sqlite independently from state/wiki_index.sqlite.
Only raw/**/*.md is indexed into heading/bounded chunks with path, line, and byte offsets.
Search is lexical FTS only, labels results as raw source candidates, and reopens canonical raw bytes for returned text.
Repeated rebuilds update only added, changed, or removed files by stat identity; status is stat-based and doctor performs exact content verification.
Raw body text is not duplicated in a regular SQLite content column and no ONNX, RRF, daemon, or canonical truth is introduced.
Focused and full repository checks pass.

stories.title: Add wiki-first raw fallback retrieval
acceptanceCriteria: Existing wiki search remains the default and keeps its output contract.
An explicit raw fallback option queries raw only when wiki lexical results are empty; direct raw search remains available for verification and ingest planning.
Wiki and raw results remain separate labeled lanes with no blended score or RRF.
Generated AGENTS.md and llm-wiki-loop teach wiki-first lookup followed by raw fallback for missing, thin, verification, or coverage cases.
SQLite-off vaults degrade honestly without blocking wiki search.
Focused and full repository checks pass.
